text: Walter Dean Myers's Fallen Angels was removed in 1999 from the Laton, CA Unified School District because it contained violence and profanity. The same year, the Livonia, MI public schools removed it as required reading because it was found to contain "too many swear words".
meta_description: Fallen Angels by Walter Dean Myers: removed in 1999 from the Laton, CA Unified School District and, as required reading, from Livonia, MI schools.
changes: Same two 1999 events, author added and 'same year' link.
